description.en: Muttaburrasaurus langdoni: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m asset length, palette, neutral biped posture, soft tissue and simplified toes artistic. QM own 15April2026 report and J Kuether foreground art anchor bulbous nasal arch and narrow tooth-lined forebeak. Full PeerJ paper NOT accessed; captcha STOP retained; no holotype accession asserted. NMA actual composite mount anchors whole body only, not 2026 skull authority. No single complete fossil scan claim.
